stem: Which sentence from “Building a Better Sandcastle” suggests that experts have a similar concern when building sandcastles?
instruction:
Read line 10 from the poem.

Add more water now and then; don’t let that sand get dry!

options.label: A
options.text: Once the sand is firm enough, they remove the wooden beams, leaving a block of sand.

options.label: B
options.text: It’s important to get the main part of the castle just right.

options.label: C
options.text: After the sandcastle is shaped, it is time to carve the details.

options.label: D
options.text: Some experts keep a spray bottle full of water nearby to keep the sand damp so it won’t crumble.

visual_elements: Add more water now and then; don’t let that sand get dry!
